# Calendar

> A local-first wall-calendar PWA built on @niclaslindstedt/oss-framework.
> A monthly view in the style of a classic Swedish wall calendar — week
> numbers, red Sundays, name days (UK & Sweden) — where clicking a date lets
> you type a short note meant to be read by you later. No reminders, no
> accounts, no server.

- App: https://niclaslindstedt.github.io/calendar/
- Source: https://github.com/niclaslindstedt/calendar
- Framework: https://github.com/niclaslindstedt/oss-framework

## Features

- Month grid, week planner, and one-row-per-day list views
- Per-day plain-text entries that shrink to fit the cell
- Country packs: start of week, ISO week numbers, name days (en-GB, sv-SE)
- Storage backends: browser, local folder, Dropbox, Google Drive
- Themes, English/Swedish UI, installable offline PWA
